segments.text: This nail polish has a 8 in metal spike.
You might think it's a V8 design, but it's actually tied to a billion dollar accident. Most nail polishes have small round caps, but Christian Louisboutuitton used heavy glass bottle
with a 8 in pointed handle. It doesn't fit a makeup bag, but the size is not random. Why 8 in? Because that's the exact height of the tallest heel
Louisboutuitton ever made. You're not holding a nail polish. You're holding his most extreme shoes. But why is a shoe designer selling nail polish at
all? Years ago, Louisboutuitton was working on a shoe prototype. His assistant was sitting next to him painting her red nails. He grabbed his polish and painted the bottom of the
shoes with that polish. That one moment created the most famous red souls. Now he sells the exact same thing that started his empire. For more brand secrets, subscribe.
